description: This file defines a PHP class 'ViewFavorites' which extends 'SugarView'. It is responsible for displaying a user's favorite items within the SuiteCRM application. The class constructs view options in its constructor and retrieves user favorite records to assign them to a Smarty template for rendering in the display() method.

classes.name: ViewFavorites
classes.description: PHP class that manages the display of user favorite records in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes view options such as hiding title, header, footer, JavaScript, subpanels, and search before calling parent constructor.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Retrieves favorites for the current user and module, and assigns them to the Smarty template for rendering.
